## What you did
- Prepared the prod PG17 cutover: blue/green Terraform in `envs/prod` (the read replica now follows the blue/green instead of being replaced), runbook in `runbooks/pg17-cutover.md`, and PR #321 opened with Maya as reviewer [1]
- Rehearsed the whole blue/green on a clone of last night's prod snapshot: green ready in 52 minutes, switchover cost 74 seconds of write downtime, no data mismatch — then tore the clone down [1]

## What changed
- The cutover window moved to **Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC**: Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night until ~06:00, Maya confirmed with Sam and has told the CSMs [8][10]
- Daniel will be on call for the API side on Sunday; he wants a ping when you start the switchover [7]
- Lior says the ingest workers need no change for the cutover, but asks for 30 minutes' notice before the switchover so he can pause the consumers cleanly [9]

## What is still open
- Update the runbook's date to the new window, then merge #321 — Maya approved it but asked you to hold the merge until the window was confirmed, which it now is [1][3][8]
- Rehearse rollback on a fresh clone Thursday 19/11 and record how long it takes and how much data is lost — it's a TODO in the runbook, since after switchover the old instance stops taking writes [1]
